overall_assessment: Extraction is accurate for MF: course_content, coursework_requirements, assessment and learning_outcomes are cleanly cut and complete in all 6 random controls, and sub-headings in learning outcomes do not truncate anything. Two real defects: an inline 'Arbeidsform og organisering' block is absorbed into coursework_requirements, and inline 'Forkunnskapskrav' lines stay in course_content; reading_list is never populated because the plan text ends with an empty 'Litteraturliste' heading.

findings.evidence:
Arbeidsform og organisering

Emnet organiseres i 6 moduler som alle må gjennomføres for å ta eksamen. Hver modul består av:
findings.description: Inside the 'Obligatoriske aktiviteter' block the plan has an 'Arbeidsform og organisering' sub-heading (modules, lectures, seminars: teaching methods). It is not recognised as a heading (not in the heading list), so it stays inside coursework_requirements and no teaching_methods row is emitted. The 'leak->teaching_methods' flag is a true positive. In MET5010 a similar heading ('Teaching and organization:') is correctly mapped, so the problem is that this one is a plain line inside the activities block.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The page reader only treats the top-level MF headings (Om studiet, Obligatoriske aktiviteter, Avsluttende vurdering/eksamen, Læringsutbytte, ...) as boundaries; 'Arbeidsform og organisering' appears as a non-heading line here and is not matched by the heading map as a line-start pattern.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a line-start pattern for '^Arbeidsform( og organisering)?:?$' mapped to teaching_methods in R/section_heading_map.R (and make sure the mf section_* config lets plain-line headings split), so it is cut out of coursework_requirements.

findings.description: An inline 'Forkunnskapskrav: ...' line at the end of the introductory text stays at the tail of course_content; no prerequisites row is emitted although the prerequisite is explicit (PPU1020: 'Godkjent opptak på Lektorprogrammet/PPU ... bestått 140 stp emner inkl. PED1010'). The 'leak->prerequisites' flags on both are true positives. Prerequisites is not a heading on the page, so the heading-based splitter cannot see it.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The prerequisites pattern in R/section_heading_map.R matches only standalone headings such as 'Forkunnskaper'; the 'Forkunnskapskrav:' label with inline text is not a line-start boundary.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a line-start pattern '^Forkunnskapskrav\b:?' mapped to prerequisites in R/section_heading_map.R, with the rest of the line kept as section text.

findings.evidence:
Overlappende emner
PPU1015 overlapper med 20 stp. mot PPU1010. Studenter som har PPU1010 fra før vil få 0 stp. uttelling for PPU1015 på karakterutskriften eller vitnemålet
Litteraturliste
findings.description: In 9 of 10 packet courses the plan text ends with a bare 'Litteraturliste' heading and no entries, so no reading_list row is produced (PRA1002 has no such heading). The extractor behaves correctly on the text it receives; the literature itself is absent from the harvested page text. Reading lists for MF are therefore effectively missing.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The literature list is probably loaded dynamically or from a separate element not captured by the MF fulltext selectors (R/extract_fulltext.R / institution_config.R), upstream of section extraction.
findings.suggested_fix: Check the MF page source for where the literature list is rendered and extend the MF fulltext/section_* selector to include it; otherwise accept that MF reading_list is empty.

findings.evidence: Ved oppmelding til emnet i Studentweb må du krysse av hvilken seminargruppe du skal være med i.
findings.description: coursework_requirements includes admin boilerplate: the standard withdrawal-deadline paragraph ('For ikke å bruke et eksamensforsøk ... trekkfristen 1. november') in every course and a Studentweb registration note in RL1010L. These are enrolment logistics, not requirements; the real requirement list is intact, so impact is small.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Block text is kept verbatim between 'Obligatoriske aktiviteter' and the next heading; .clean_sections() has no MF-specific boilerplate stripping.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections() for mf, strip the paragraph starting 'Studenter som ikke oppfyller de obligatoriske aktivitetene' and the 'Ved oppmelding til emnet i Studentweb' paragraph.
